interpretation.production_worker_lane: Observed current production runtime, retained as an alternate pre-WP0 algorithm lane; it is not called a tuned or accepted v2 algorithm.
interpretation.same_algorithm_corpus_bridge: Compare c143_legacy with c157_legacy (or the two production-worker lanes) to attribute corpus/projection/vocabulary changes while holding algorithm bytes fixed.
interpretation.algorithm_bridge: Compare algorithms within a fixed corpus; do not attribute this delta to the corpus.
interpretation.held_out_status: The v0.1.0 held-out gold was already published and evaluated by the legacy baseline. These 20 questions remain audit-only and are not a sealed final-gate hold-out for tuning.
